sentences.en: On Thursday night, President Biden used the final State of the Union address of his first term to make his case for a second term and to prosecute his case against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，拜登总统在第一任期内的最后一次国情咨文中，为自己竞选连任阐述了理由，并对唐纳德·特朗普提出了抨击。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, White House reporter Jim Tankersley, walks us through the biggest moments of the speech.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、白宫记者吉姆·坦克雷斯基将带我们回顾这场演讲中最重大的时刻。

sentences.en: Friday, March 8th.
sentences.zh: 3月8日，星期五。

sentences.en: So Jim, good evening and thank you for staying up with us for what I have always thought of as the Super Bowl for nerds in Washington, the State of the Union.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，晚上好。谢谢你陪我们熬夜观看这场我一直认为是华盛顿特区“书呆子超级碗”的活动——国情咨文。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Although the Super Bowl starts about three hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 尽管超级碗要早大约三个小时开始。

sentences.en: So it's in some ways a little easier.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上稍微容易一些。

sentences.en: And ends roughly around the same time.
sentences.zh: 而且结束的时间大致差不多。

sentences.en: Right, roughly around the same time.
sentences.zh: 没错，大致差不多。

sentences.en: And has commercials, kind of fun commercials, which we didn't get here.
sentences.zh: 而且还有广告，那种挺有意思的广告，我们这里可没有。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 没有，确实没有。

sentences.en: So it's kind of impossible to separate this State of the Union from the moment in which it's being delivered, which is the start of a general election campaign for president
sentences.zh: 所以，要想把这次国情咨文与它发表的背景完全剥离几乎是不可能的，这个背景就是总统大选初选的开始。

sentences.en: that has started so much faster than I think anyone had expected.
sentences.zh: 这场选举开始的速度比任何人预期的都要快得多。

sentences.en: In this case, the speech comes just a day after Donald Trump's last rival drops out of the race.
sentences.zh: 在这次演讲前仅仅一天，唐纳德·特朗普的最后一位竞争对手就宣布退选了。

sentences.en: The Republican primary is now over, and the race for the White House is officially whittled down now to Trump versus Biden.
sentences.zh: 共和党初选现在已经结束，白宫争夺战正式缩减为特朗普对阵拜登。

sentences.en: And it's at this moment that President Biden delivers this State of the Union.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时刻，拜登总统发表了这份国情咨文。

sentences.en: So with all that in mind, what, heading into this night, Jim, do we understand to be Biden's mission with this speech?
sentences.zh: 因此，考虑到这一切，吉姆，在今晚开始之前，我们认为拜登通过这次演讲的核心任务是什么？

sentences.en: The timing makes this speech extraordinary, sort of historically.
sentences.zh: 从某种历史角度来看，这个时机让这次演讲非同寻常。

sentences.en: I think we can overemphasize the importance of State of the Union speeches sometimes, but not this one.
sentences.zh: 我想我们有时可能会过分强调国情咨文的重要性，但这次绝对不同。

sentences.en: This is definitely one of the most important speeches Joe Biden has given as president, if not the most important thus far.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是乔·拜登作为总统发表的最重要的演讲之一，如果不是迄今为止最重要的一次的话。

sentences.en: And it's important because he's not winning this race.
sentences.zh: 它之所以重要，是因为他的选情并不占优势。

sentences.en: The polls do not show him beating Donald Trump right now, and it shows massive headwinds facing his re-election campaign.
sentences.zh: 民调显示他目前并没有击败唐纳德·特朗普，这表明他的连任竞选正面临巨大的逆风。

sentences.en: Voters do not approve of the job he's doing as president.
sentences.zh: 选民并不认可他作为总统的工作表现。

sentences.en: They think he is too old, and they do not buy what he is selling on his policy record right now.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他年纪太大了，而且目前并不买账他在政策政绩上宣传的那一套。

sentences.en: So Biden comes into this speech wanting to reset all of those.
sentences.zh: 因此，拜登发表这次演讲是为了重塑所有这些形象。

sentences.en: These are his goals.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的目标。

sentences.en: He wants to tell some new stories about policy, about the economy, about abortion, about foreign policy that make him look a lot better.
sentences.zh: 他希望讲述一些关于政策、经济、堕胎和外交政策的新故事，让自己看起来好得多。

sentences.en: He wants to draw contrasts with Trump that make Biden look more likable and more preferable to Trump than voters had been thinking coming into the speech.
sentences.zh: 他希望与特朗普形成对比，让选民觉得拜登比他们在听演讲前想象的更讨人喜欢、更合心意。

sentences.en: And maybe most importantly, he wants to dispel or at least quiet these concerns about his age by showing himself to be sort of a vigorous Joe Biden who's up for the job.
sentences.zh: 或许最重要的是，他希望通过展现自己是一个胜任工作的、充满活力的乔·拜登，来消除或至少平息外界对他年龄的担忧。

sentences.en: With all that in mind, walk us through the speech itself and how Biden sought to navigate all of these issues and challenges he faces.
sentences.zh: 考虑到所有这些，请带我们了解一下演讲本身，以及拜登是如何试图应对他所面临的所有这些问题和挑战的。

sentences.en: It's a really interesting start.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的开场。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，美国总统。

sentences.en: He kicks off with a joke.
sentences.zh: 他以一个笑话开场。

sentences.en: He hears all the applause and says,
sentences.zh: 他听到全场掌声，然后说道：

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好。

sentences.en: If I were smart, I'd go home now.
sentences.zh: 我要是聪明的话，现在就回家了。

sentences.en: And then from that moment of levity, he pivots quickly into a very serious section when he lays out threats to democracy and freedom abroad and at home.
sentences.zh: 然后，从那个轻松的时刻起，他迅速切入了一个非常严肃的部分，阐述了对国内外民主和自由的威胁。

sentences.en: Putin of Russia is on the march, invading Ukraine and sowing chaos throughout Europe and beyond.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的普京正在步步紧逼，入侵乌克兰并在欧洲及其他地区播下混乱的种子。

sentences.en: He starts with the war in Ukraine and with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 他从乌克兰战争和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京切入。

sentences.en: And he talks about him and compares him basically to Hitler on the march in Europe.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了普京，基本上把他比作在欧洲进犯的希特勒。

sentences.en: If anybody in this room thinks Putin will stop at Ukraine, I assure you he will not.
sentences.zh: 如果这个房间里的任何人认为普京会在乌克兰止步，我向你们保证，他绝不会。

sentences.en: And casts America and the Biden presidency as crucial to stopping this march.
sentences.zh: 并将美国和拜登政府塑造成阻止这一进犯的关键力量。

sentences.en: And then he tosses in what will be a real sign of what's to come, which is his first swipe at Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 接着，他抛出了一个真正预示着未来的信号，那就是他对唐纳德·特朗普的首次抨击。

sentences.en: Now my predecessor, a former Republican president tells Putin, quote, do whatever the hell you want.
sentences.zh: 现在，我的前任，一位前共和党总统对普京说，引述原话：“想干什么就干什么去吧。”

sentences.en: That's a quote.
sentences.zh: 原话就是这样。

sentences.en: He quotes him and accuses him of bowing down to Putin.
sentences.zh: 他引用了这句话，并指责普京的谄媚。

sentences.en: I think it's outrageous, it's dangerous, and it's unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 我认为这令人发指、极其危险且不可接受。

sentences.en: From Russia, Biden jumps to the United States, and he's continuing to build sort of this case against Trump.
sentences.zh: 从俄罗斯，拜登转回美国，并继续构建针对特朗普的这种论点。

sentences.en: History is watching, just like history watched three years ago on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 历史在看着，就像三年前的1月6日历史看着一样。

sentences.en: Now he starts talking about the January 6th riots at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 现在他开始谈论1月6日国会山骚乱事件。

sentences.en: Many of you are here on that darkest of days.
sentences.zh: 你们当中有许多人就在那个最黑暗的日子里在场。

sentences.en: We all saw with our own eyes the insurrectionists were not patriots.
sentences.zh: 我们都亲眼看到，那些暴徒并非爱国者。

sentences.en: They'd come to stop the peaceful transfer of power, to oversturn the will of the people.
sentences.zh: 他们来这里是为了阻止权力的和平移交，推翻人民的意志。

sentences.en: He calls it the greatest threat to U.S.
sentences.zh: 他称这是自内战以来对美国民主的最大威胁。

sentences.en: democracy since the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 这是说出真相、埋葬谎言的时刻。

sentences.en: This is the moment to speak the truth and to bury the lies.
sentences.zh: 并且他说特朗普试图掩盖真相。

sentences.en: And he says that Trump tried to bury the truth.
sentences.zh: 你不能只有在获胜时才爱国。

sentences.en: You can't love your country only when you win.
sentences.zh: 这里的潜台词很难错失。

sentences.en: The subtext here is hard to mess.
sentences.zh: 拜登是在说，特朗普是欧洲民主和美国民主的威胁。

sentences.en: Biden is saying Trump is a threat to democracy in Europe and to democracy in the United States.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，人们逐渐看清，这将是一场与唐纳德·特朗普息息相关的国情咨文。

sentences.en: And it becomes clear around this moment that this is going to be a State of the Union that has a lot to do with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 是的，唐纳德·特朗普就像是这场演讲中没有被点名的主角。

sentences.en: Yeah, Donald Trump is like the unnamed main character in this speech.
sentences.zh: 当你与拜登的助手和盟友交谈时，他们对美国人对特朗普几乎患上“健忘症”的现象都感到困惑不解，无论是多大程度的困惑，

sentences.en: When you talk to Biden aides and his allies, they're all a little bit or a lot mystified at what they see as Americans sort of almost amnesia about Trump,
sentences.zh: 不仅是对特朗普担任总统期间那种混乱局面的遗忘，也是对他的政策所产生的后果的遗忘。

sentences.en: not just sort of the chaos of the years that Trump was president, but also the effects of his policies.
sentences.zh: 他们认为人们对他的回忆带有过多的怀旧色彩，拜登显然在这次演讲中着手改变这种状况。

sentences.en: They think people are sort of remembering him overly nostalgically in a way that Biden clearly sets out in this speech to try to change.
sentences.zh: 在谈完关于民主的这段话之后，他采取的下一个方式就是谈论堕胎和生育自由。

sentences.en: And the next way he does that after this riff about democracy is by talking about abortion and reproductive freedom.
sentences.zh: 和大多数美国人一样，我相信罗诉韦德案的判决是正确的。

sentences.en: Like most Americans, I believe Roe v.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了为什么在拜登看来，罗诉韦德案做出了正确的裁决，但由特朗普任命的大法官组成的最高法院却推翻了它，而他知道民调显示美国人大多对此非常不满。

sentences.en: Wade got it right.
sentences.zh: 他就是被推翻的原因。

sentences.en: He talks about how Roe v.
sentences.zh: 而且他还引以为傲。

sentences.en: Wade, in Biden's view, was correctly decided, but a Supreme Court with justices appointed by Trump overturned it, which he knows Americans in the polling largely do not like.
sentences.zh: 看看由此导致的混乱。

sentences.en: He's the reason it was overturned.
sentences.zh: 然后他谈到了这导致了生殖自由的进一步侵蚀，包括最近阿拉巴马州关于体外受精（IVF）的裁决。

sentences.en: And he brags about it.
sentences.zh: 你们这个议事厅里的许多人和我的前任都在承诺通过一项针对生殖自由的全国性禁令。

sentences.en: Look at the chaos that has resulted.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪，你们还要剥夺什么其他的自由？

sentences.en: And then he talks about that leading to further erosion of reproductive freedoms, including the recent Alabama decision about IVF.
sentences.zh: 紧接着有一个非常不寻常的时刻，他转向了出席演讲的最高法院大法官们。

sentences.en: Many of you in this chamber and my predecessor are promising to pass a national ban on reproductive freedom.
sentences.zh: 虽然不是全部，但有几位在场。

sentences.en: My God, what freedom else would you take away?
sentences.zh: 并对他们说……

sentences.en: And there's this sort of extraordinary moment where he turns to the members of the Supreme Court who are there at the speech.
sentences.zh: 恕我直言，大法官阁下，女性并非没有选举权。

sentences.en: It's not all of them, but it's several of them.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，是选举或政治力量。

sentences.en: And tells them...
sentences.zh: 你们很快就会意识到你们……

sentences.en: With all due respect, justices, women are not without electoral power.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是说，嘿，你们在低估女性。

sentences.en: Excuse me, electoral or political power.
sentences.zh: 你们在低估自己推翻罗诉韦德案所造成的后果。

sentences.en: You're about to realize just how much you...
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Basically, hey, you're underestimating women.
sentences.zh: 实际上，正是在他对大法官们说话的这一刻，他表现出了最浓厚的竞选色彩。

sentences.en: You're underestimating what you have wrought with your decision striking down row.
sentences.zh: 他甚至直言不讳地表示，在2024年，女性将展现她们的力量。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我确实觉得这不仅是一场异常关注其竞争对手的国情咨文，而且在展现其总统竞选意图方面也异常公开。

sentences.en: And it's actually in this moment of him speaking to the justices that he becomes his most overtly kind of campaign-y.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He actually says that in 2024, women will show their power.
sentences.zh: 然后拜登转向了经济议题，在那里他确实面临着一项巨大的任务，但他也认为这是一个改变美国人对拜登及拜登政绩看法的重大机遇。

sentences.en: And in that moment, I certainly felt like this was going to be not just a State of the Union that was unusually focused on his rival, but that was unusually open in the way
sentences.zh: 这并没有登上成千上万个城镇的新闻，但美国人民正在书写一段从未被讲述过的最伟大的卷土重来的故事。

sentences.en: that it was about his presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 他试图重新讲述这个国家从大流行引发的经济衰退中复苏的故事，这一次不再把自己塑造成引发让美国人生气的通货膨胀的“恶棍”，而是塑造成创造了令世界艳羡的复苏的“英雄”。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 美国的卷土重来正在构建美国无限可能性的未来。

sentences.en: And then Biden turns to the economy where he really has sort of a big task, but also he thinks a big opportunity to try to change the way Americans think about Biden
sentences.zh: 从中间向外、从底层到顶层构建经济，而不是从顶层向下。

sentences.en: and Biden's record.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始讲述这个故事，细数他的政策如何帮助经济发展的方方面面。

sentences.en: It doesn't make new, but news in a thousand cities and towns, the American people are writing the greatest comeback story never told.
sentences.zh: 种族财富差距达到了20年来的最小水平。

sentences.en: He's sort of retelling the story of the country's recovery from the pandemic recession and trying to cast himself this time not as the villain who unleashed inflation
sentences.zh: 工资不断上涨。

sentences.en: that Americans are angry about, but as the hero who has created a recovery that's the envy of the world.
sentences.zh: 通货膨胀不断下降。

sentences.en: America's comeback is building the future of American possibilities.
sentences.zh: 通货膨胀率已经从9%降至3%，是世界最低水平，甚至还有比10%更低的。

sentences.en: Building an economy from the middle out and the bottom up, not the top down.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你，迈克尔，我每天都报道这些内容。

sentences.en: And he starts telling this story, running through all the ways in which his policies helped the economy.
sentences.zh: 我对这些东西了如指掌。

sentences.en: The racial wealth gap is as small as it's been in 20 years.
sentences.zh: 你确实很懂。

sentences.en: Wages keep going up.

sentences.en: Inflation keeps coming down.

sentences.en: Inflation has dropped from 9% to 3%, the lowest in the world, and 10% even lower.

sentences.en: And I got to tell you, Michael, I covered this stuff every day.
sentences.zh: 但在这些经济相关的部分，有时他简直是在飞速宣讲。

sentences.en: I know this stuff really well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我认为那绝不是偶然。

sentences.en: You do.
sentences.zh: 我认为这恰恰说明了你之前提到的拜登今晚的目标之一，那就是展现活力。

sentences.en: Biden starts going so fast and sort of so animatedly that it was hard for me to keep up.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在演讲期间有些时刻，我戴着和你听节目时一样的耳机，

sentences.en: And now, instead of importing foreign products and exporting American jobs, we're exporting American products and creating American jobs.
sentences.zh: 却不得不调低音量并摘下耳机，因为拜登几乎是在大喊大叫。

sentences.en: And it takes him a while to sort of settle down and kind of relax into the speech.
sentences.zh: 感觉这是总统刻意做出的一种努力，仿佛在说：我非常清醒地在这里发表这次演讲。

sentences.en: But in these economic parts in particular, he's just, at times, just flying through.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I don't think that was an accident.
sentences.zh: 而当他真正放松下来的时候，往往是他几乎打破常规或者脱离稿子，去调侃台下共和党人的时候。

sentences.en: And I think it speaks to one of the things you said about what Biden's goal was tonight, which was to be energetic.
sentences.zh: 全美各地已经宣布了46000个新项目。

sentences.en: I mean, there were moments during the speech I was listening in the same pair of headphones
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我注意到你们当中有些人强烈投票反对它，却在那里为资金到位欢呼雀跃。
